verdict.rationale: Testing sends without delivering real email is a fair axis for a transactional email API, but the evidence pack never documents a sandbox domain, test mode, or test API keys for MailerSend. The webhook verification test request (docs-7) only checks that an endpoint URL is reachable; it does not provide a non-delivering send mode, so it is adjacent and earns no credit. The free trial (docs-24) is not a test environment either.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test sends without delivering real email — a sandbox domain, test mode, or test API keys that accept messages and fire events, safe for CI and agents
